name: PDF
description: Merge, split, and reorganize PDFs in your browser.

pdf-merge.name: Merge PDFs
pdf-merge.description: Combine several PDFs into one, in the order you choose — on your device.

pdf-split.name: Extract Pages
pdf-split.description: Pull a page selection out of a PDF into a new file — on your device.

pdf-rotate.name: Rotate PDF
pdf-rotate.description: Turn all pages or a selection by 90, 180, or 270 degrees — on your device.

pdf-delete.name: Delete Pages
pdf-delete.description: Remove unwanted pages and keep the rest — on your device.

pdf-reorder.name: Reorder Pages
pdf-reorder.description: Rearrange a PDF's pages into a new order — on your device.

ui.dropTitle: Drop a PDF here, or click to choose
ui.dropTitleMany: Drop PDFs here, or click to choose
ui.dropMore: Drop another PDF, or click to add more
ui.dropHint: Files are processed right here — nothing is uploaded.
ui.rangeHint: Use page numbers and ranges, like 1-3, 7, 12- (this file has {count}).
ui.rangeInvalid: That selection doesn't match this document's pages.
ui.deleteAllInvalid: That would delete every page — a PDF needs at least one.
ui.mergeNeedTwo: Add at least two PDFs to merge.
ui.mergeAction: Merge into one PDF ({count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}})
ui.splitAction: Extract {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}
ui.rotateAction: Rotate {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} & download
ui.deleteAction: Delete {removed, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}, keep {kept}
ui.errorLoad: Couldn't open that file as a PDF. It may be corrupted or password-protected.
ui.errorSave: Couldn't produce the new PDF. The file may use features this tool can't rewrite.
ui.privacy: Your documents never leave this device — everything happens in your browser.
